contexts.rationale: CanonicalLedger._canonicalAdd scans only its bounded current currency list for duplicates before appending one asset. It has no external calls in the scan. The uncached length is stable, and the per-domain admitted inventory bounds its total work.

CanonicalLedger._canonicalValidateBacking iterates the captured/imported currency list and checks physical balance>=captured amount+prefund. ERC20 balanceOf is STATICCALL; native balance is direct. No callback may mutate the list. Token failure can block validation, so this is not universal token availability.

Royalty canonicalActivate examines at most65 admitted currencies while still inert/importing. It classifies all actual balance above accounted as prefund/orphaned and then sets current eligibility; these prefunds do not duplicate imported holder liabilities. Static balance reads cannot append assets during this loop.

Royalty canonicalValidate checks each admitted currency (<=65) for imported accrued sum==liabilities and GCD cursor divisibility, then exact physical backing. No external mutable read can enroll another NFT or currency. Length caching cannot replace these distinct conservation checks.

FeesCanonical.canonicalCapture clears accepted flags over its old <=33 asset list before deleting/rebuilding snapshot arrays, after fees.canonicalBarrier. There are no external calls or list-size changes in this clear loop. The subsequent finite LP-asset/group dimensions are independently bounded.

Rewards.checkpointAll captures the NFT collective eligibility once, then checkpoints every admitted LP reward asset. The loop contains static dependencies and ledger writes, no external mutable balance call; asset inventory is bounded and eligibility cannot change mid-loop. Caching length is optional and does not alter the required per-currency checkpoint.

ContributionPricing._clear deletes per-asset mark mappings, then deletes the assets array and basis after the loop. There are no external calls or in-loop array-length changes. Caching length is optional; moving deletion earlier would instead skip cleanup.

Rewards.canonicalCapture loops the bounded LP-reward asset inventory under frozen parent lifecycle, requiring physical balance>=liabilities+orphaned and registering unique captured amounts. Static balance reads cannot modify the list. It does not convert a claim/import into new revenue.

Rewards.checkpointOwner captures the current NFT bucket/shares before its asset loop; only the nonReentrant Vault can change those shares. Each currency settles that pre-contribution snapshot through static reads and ledger writes. This prevents new shares taking prior personal LP fees; length caching is a performance suggestion.

Royalty canonicalCapture loops at most65 admitted currencies only after finalized opening and every initial sync. It snapshots physical excess over accounted into a frozen pending vector while retaining the source books for abort. Parent lifecycle and read-only token balance prevent an in-loop append; capacity gas remains a release qualification.

FeesCanonical.canonicalValidate checks the <=33 captured LP-asset balances at the fixed fee controller against captured amounts, after complete-cursor checks. Balance reads are static; no list append happens during validation. Frozen/malicious assets may block restoration, which length caching cannot cure.

canonicalValidate walks the fixed captured/imported backingAssets array, bounded<=33 by source capture/header import, and uses static balance checks against backingAmounts. No mutable callback can append an asset while validation is executing. Caching its length could save reads but neither changes solvency nor removes the need to qualify target gas/token behavior.

CanonicalLedger._canonicalBeginCapture clears delivery/acceptance flags over the old finite asset inventory, then deletes asset/amount/prefund arrays. No external call or length mutation occurs during the clear loop; caching length is a possible cost improvement without accounting effect.
